prompt: A mountain campsite with a tent pitched on a flat clearing. A campfire is burning in front of the tent. A backpack leans against a tree to the left of the tent. A pair of hiking boots is beside the backpack. A map is spread on a rock near the campfire. The tree is taller than the tent. Two water bottles are standing next to the boots. Near the backpack are some granola bars, and the number of granola bars is twice the number of water bottles. A sleeping bag is rolled up inside the tent. A lantern hangs from a branch above the campfire. A cooler, which is wider than the backpack, is placed behind the fire.
